review_findings.title: Coverage is incomplete
review_findings.detail: This is a bounded official-source inventory, not a full list of every SF event. Library programs, sports, concerts, theatre, civic meetings, neighborhood and private events remain incompletely researched. No coverage percentage is known.

review_findings.title: Fleet Fest / ship tours: past edition
review_findings.detail: Official page describes October 2026 dates already past at review. Retained as research finding, not promoted as upcoming. Next edition unverified.

review_findings.title: SFMOMA Community Days: no date
review_findings.detail: Official upcoming date is TBD. No date inferred or event occurrence generated.

review_findings.title: How Weird Street Faire is discontinued but still listed as active
review_findings.detail: The organizer's own site reads '2000 — 2024 ... The Faire is done.' Several third-party calendars still list it as an annual San Francisco event. Not admitted as a row.

review_findings.title: Ghirardelli Chocolate Festival: no current edition on the venue's page
review_findings.detail: Ghirardelli Square's official events page lists no Chocolate Festival for 2026 or 2027; the last documented edition was the 23rd in September 2018. Not admitted as an active annual row.

review_findings.title: Recurring geography false positive: events outside the city
review_findings.detail: The Great Dickens Christmas Fair (Cow Palace, Daly City) and Super Bowl LX, FIFA World Cup 2026 matches and 49ers games (Levi's Stadium, Santa Clara) are routinely listed as San Francisco events. Excluded by the city-only rule.

review_findings.title: Conflicting hours across official pages (4 events)
review_findings.detail: Alemany Farmers Market: sf.gov says Saturday 7am-2pm while the City's own Farmers Market Rules and Regs PDF says 7 AM-3 PM. Heart of the City Farmers' Market: the operator's About page says 7am-4pm while other pages on the same site say Sunday 7am-5pm / Wednesday 7am-5:30pm. Castro Night Market: 5-9pm in some official listings versus 5-10pm on the organizer site and in the SFMTA advisory. Chinatown Autumn Moon Festival: organizer 11am-5pm versus SFMTA 11am-6pm. Disputed values are left blank on the affected rows.

review_findings.title: Stale official pages (6 events)
review_findings.detail: Haight Ashbury Street Fair's About page still says the fair is 'held every second Sunday in June' while the 2026 fair was held Sunday, September 20. sf.gov's Filipino American History Month page still lists the previous FilBookFest edition (October 12-13, theme KAISÁ'T KASAMA) while sfpl.org lists October 17-18, 2026, theme SANGGALAN. Castro Street Fair, Union Street Festival, Pistahan, North Beach Festival and the Greek Food Festival pages still present 2026 content as current.

review_findings.title: Unstable edition numbers
review_findings.detail: North Beach Festival is described as both the 70th and 71st for June 2026; the Chinatown Autumn Moon Festival as both the 35th and 36th. Neither number is asserted in the register.

review_findings.title: Dates moved or tentative after announcement
review_findings.detail: San Francisco Opera Ball was rescheduled from September 12 to November 12, 2026 over orchestra labor negotiations. SF Ballet's site shows Nutcracker as both Dec 4-27 (2026-27 season pages) and Dec 5-28 (renewals page). MLB published the Giants' 2027 schedule as tentative pending labor negotiations, so the March 25, 2027 home opener may shift.

review_findings.title: SOMA Nights — excluded: official source unreachable
review_findings.detail: Official site soma-nights.com returned an SSL error / HTTP 500 on re-check; no other official page confirms the 2026 edition. Row removed from the register and recorded on Flagged for Review rather than published unverified.

review_findings.title: Duplicate rows merged during final review
review_findings.detail: Two pairs described the same event: 'Legion of Honor Free Tuesdays' duplicated the FAMSF free-first-Tuesday entry (FAMSF confirms free general admission on the first Tuesday of every month), and 'After Dark: Unplug and Play' appeared once for November 12 and once for December 10, 2026. Merged, with both dates preserved.

review_findings.title: Session a1b7522f: expanded coverage for sports, theatre, zoo, Presidio, and library events
review_findings.detail: Added 20 new rows from official sources: NBA (nba.com/warriors), WNBA (valkyries.wnba.com), A.C.T. (act-sf.org), Curran Theatre (sfcurran.com), SF Zoo (sfzoo.org), Presidio Trust (presidio.gov), SFPL (sfpl.org), and SF Marathon (thesfmarathon.com). All verified 2026-10-18.

review_findings.title: Geography note: San Francisco Marathon crosses into Marin County
review_findings.detail: The SF Marathon course crosses the Golden Gate Bridge into Sausalito, Marin County, before returning to San Francisco. The start and finish lines are within city limits, and the majority of the route is in SF. Retained with a geography flag for manual review.

review_findings.title: Integration reclassified three rows and removed one non-event
review_findings.detail: Final integration found two duplicate Carnaval rows in the 86-row register (merged), the Chinese New Year Parade and Carnaval rows filed as 'Special' even though both are annual editions (moved to Annual), and the 'After Dark: Creepatorium' theme filed as Annual even though it is a single dated theme of the weekly After Dark series (moved to Special). The Hardly Strictly Bluegrass online merchandise-store window was removed: it is a retail window, not an event.

review_findings.title: Two registers merged: overlapping rows reconciled by hand

A fuzzy matcher was rejected because it proposed false pairs (for example Frameline vs International Ocean Film Festival).

review_findings.title: Several rows cite a landing or listing page rather than the event page
review_findings.detail: A number of inherited rows cite an official organizer landing page that lists several events (for example pcfma.org/visit for four farmers markets, or sfopera.com's season press page for several productions). The automated check confirms the page loads and mentions the event name where it does; these rows are marked 'page-level' rather than 'field-level' verification. Field-level means a prior session transcribed the individual values; page-level means only the page and its mention of the event were re-checked automatically.

review_findings.title: Earlier findings superseded by the final register
